tributeSays.line: ⛓️ Linda brings it home: The Hungry Road bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.
🗣️ Word with the traders: Emberhold sent Thornfield grain when their stores ran thin — no tribute, no ceremony, just food on the road. That's a thing villages DO now.
